credit: つくよみちゃんコーパス（CV.夢前黎） https://tyc.rei-yumesaki.net/material/corpus/
role: V1. Channel A is synthesised by the M2 speaker-inversion embedding; channel B is the same frozen speaker as V-real.

terms.inherited_from: tsukuyomi-corpus-v1 (via the M2 embedding, which was trained on it)
terms.training_use: Permitted. Irodori-TTS is MIT and places no terms on generated audio; the corpus permits voice-synthesis use explicitly.
terms.redistribution: Withheld pending the publication review, since the voice derives from the corpus.
terms.credit_on_publication: 本ソフトウェアの音声合成には、フリー素材キャラクター「つくよみちゃん」が無料公開している音声データを使用しています。

notes: Speaker B is the same frozen wav in both datasets, byte for byte, so the two differ only in channel A.
Only the corpus TRAIN split is used. The 10 dev and 10 test sentences never enter either dataset, because condition 4 is measured on held-out audio.
The 72/8 split comes from m3/scripts/split-map-v1.json and is shared by both datasets, so the comparison stays paired.
Audio is gitignored. The scripts, split map, manifest and reports are committed.
Channel A runs 9.47 minutes against V-real's 8.67 because the TTS speaks slightly slower than the corpus. Reported, not gated: no parity threshold was pre-registered.
